month_rule: a card belongs to the calendar month its 30-day window ended in

accuracy.what_this_board_measures: Did what the card predicted come true. Graded on the prediction alone; needs no owner action, and reads neither the arm, the inferred action, the votes nor the money.
accuracy.hit_rule: lift >= 1.0: the product sold at least what its own trailing rate projected over the 30-day window
refusals: no card's 30-day window closed in this month
promise fill: no card asked for a quantity
interval coverage: no range stored on any card this month
stockout grade: no stockout card closed this month

holdout.what_this_board_measures: Did telling the store change anything. Shown against withheld, per product; dollars are per product, never totals; the action is inferred from the purchases feed, an uploaded invoice, the stock delta or a price drop. This board states no hit rate.

difference.refused_reason: needs 5 measured outcomes per arm; have 0 shown and 0 withheld

totals_for_the_record.note: The arms are different sizes by design; the difference is taken per product above.

summary.line: holdout 30d NOT YET MEASURABLE - needs 5 measured outcomes per arm; have 0 shown and 0 withheld

difference: needs 5 measured outcomes per arm; have 0 shown and 0 withheld
